summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, furnishing a May 18, 2026 news release providing a Q1 2026 corporate update. The update highlights commercial progress across its four core quantum technology business lines: QCIM, QPerfect (acquisition pending), QSSN, and Bitcoin Quantum. No specific deal terms, stake percentages, or pricing are disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly business update and does not constitute a special situation. It describes ongoing operations and strategic initiatives without announcing an event triggering a special-situations category.
